chunks: I asked one of them, peace be upon them, about a man whose wife said to him, “I ask you by the Face of Allah, that you not fail to divorce me.” He said: “He should strike her painfully, or forgive her.”

key_terms.أَحَدَهُمَا: one of the two Imams referred to by the narrator
key_terms.بِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ: by the Face of Allah; an oath-like appeal invoking Allah

ai.seo_question: Does a wife’s plea by Allah obligate her husband to divorce her in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal response concerning a wife invoking Allah in asking her husband to divorce her. The Imam عليهما السلام gives a ruling indicating that such a statement does not itself compel divorce, and the husband may either discipline her or pardon her.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
I asked one of the Imams (as) about a man whose wife said to him, "I ask you, for the sake of Allah (swt), to divorce me."
Imam (as) said: "He should either discipline her with a beating or forgive her."
